qa_pairs.question: What kind of information is provided by the power graph on a CPU task page?
qa_pairs.answer: The power graph on a CPU task page provides a graphical representation of the power used.

qa_pairs.question: Where can users find a visual display of the power consumed by a specific CPU task?
qa_pairs.answer: Users can find a visual display of the power used by a specific CPU task on its dedicated CPU task page.
